templates.description: The Level 1 recommendations from the CIS Google Android benchmark that map to Android Management API policy fields. Many recommendations cover Google account settings or on-device UI that an EMM cannot control, so they remain listed as unmapped. This is not a reproduction of the benchmark text.

A reviewed subset of the Level 1 recommendations expressible through configuration profiles. Controls that need filesystem state, audit configuration, or a DDM declaration stay listed as unmapped. This is not a reproduction of the benchmark text.

A reviewed subset of the Level 1 recommendations that the Mattrax Windows policy catalogue can express. Controls that have no reliable catalogue mapping stay listed as unmapped. This is not a reproduction of the benchmark; see the CIS document for the authoritative text.
